title: Mahendra Cecil Bailey v. State of U.P.
coram: Sunita Agarwal, J.; Deepak Verma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; billing dispute relegated to clause 6.5.
headnote: A writ petition raising only a dispute about an electricity bill is not entertainable. The consumer must approach the Executive Engineer concerned under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Mahendra Cecil Bailey alias Mahendra Vali filed Writ-C No. 7028 of 2021 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and three others, raising a dispute concerning an electricity bill. The Division Bench of Sunita Agarwal and Deepak Verma JJ. heard the matter on 16 March 2021. Umair Mahmood appeared for the petitioner; the Chief Standing Counsel and Pranjal Mehrotra appeared for the respondents. The order records no particulars of the bill, the connection, or any prior representation under the Supply Code.

holding_units.topic: billing dispute relegated to Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: A writ petition raising a dispute regarding an electricity bill cannot be entertained. The appropriate course is to approach the Executive Engineer concerned in accordance with clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The petition was dismissed.

principle_tags.application: The Division Bench refused to entertain a billing-dispute writ and sent the petitioner to the Executive Engineer under clause 6.5, treating that statutory representation as the proper remedy.
The only dispute raised was about the electricity bill, and clause 6.5 was identified as the statutory course before the Executive Engineer.

not_decided.note: The merits of the billing dispute were not examined; the petitioner was directed to the Executive Engineer under clause 6.5.
